Phil COMPLETED 研究專長 Objectives Research and development work in Heuristic Computational Intelligence techniques and their applications in Social & Physical sciences, as well as, in fractional order systems in Engineering and Physical Sciences. Research Interests The topic of my PhD studies is mathematical modeling and analytical solutions techniques of fluidic problems. Key areas of my research interest are Evolutionary Computation, Swarm Intelligence, Fractional Calculus, Fractional differential equation. Numerical Computing, Particle swarm optimization, Genetic Algorithm, Neural Networks, Mathematical Modeling of Fluid dynamic system, Perturbation Techniques, Evolutionary Spline Methods, Finite Difference Methods, etc.
